text:
maya: Quick heads-up — finished a multi-region latency sweep for the new rdlx-4b quantized build (4-bit) across us-east / us-west / eu-west. Posting raw p50/p95 snapshots and routing notes.

frank: awesome, can you include GPU types and whether KV cache was warm?

maya: yep — tests ran on A100 and H100 pools. Warmup was limited (100 requests) for the baseline run; I wanted to capture realistic cold-start impact from edge routing.

maya: raw table (csv style) from perf-bot: 
```
Region,GPU,p50_ms,p95_ms,throughput_tok_s
us-east,A100,42,210,3200
us-east,H100,30,170,4200
us-west,A100,48,260,3000
eu-west,H100,55,330,2600
us-west,H100,35,180,4000
eu-west,A100,62,380,2400
```

cameron: interesting numbers. p95 inflation in eu-west looks bad on A100. Was that the default routing policy?

maya: yes — default edge routing was "prefer-nearest-pop" but we had a transient fallback to cross-pop when local capacity hit a soft cap. That triggered cross-pop sessions where KV cache missed and we saw extra tail.

perf-bot: [run 1912345678] aggregated percentiles and throughput attached. Link: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1912345678 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

frank: can you paste the benchmark command you ran?

maya: sure:
```
python bench.py --model rdlx-4b-quant --regions us-east,us-west,eu-west --gpus a100,h100 --concurrency 16 --warmup 100 --seq-len 512 --requests 2000
```

sophia: two quick thoughts — 1) kernel selection matters: flash-attention-v2 vs fused-qk-kernel gave ~10-15% lower p50 on H100 in our microtests. 2) prefix/KV cache warmup reduces p95 a lot for cross-pop.

cameron: can we reproduce with forced warm KV? i.e., run a warm-phase that touches prefixes on all pops before measuring. Also try routing policy set to "local-only" to see pure-local SLOs.

maya: scheduled follow-up: re-run with warm=1000 and routing=local-only, and another with routing="cost-priority" (prefer cheaper pop even if cross-pop). I'll dump new CSVs.

frank: capacity-sizing note — for rdlx-4b-quant on H100 we saw ~4.0k tok/s in us-east H100 line; rough rule-of-thumb: 1 H100 can handle ~4000 tok/s at p95 SLO=250ms for mixed traffic. We'll refine with concurrency sweeps.

perf-bot: quick kernel compare from microbench: H100 + flash-attn-v2 => p50 - 8ms vs fused-qk, p95 - 20ms improvement under 16 conc.

maya: anecdotal: when cross-pop fallback happened we saw a KV miss rate jump from 3% -> 18% and tail latencies doubled. Logs snippet: 
```
[us-west-pop] kv_cache.miss_count += 180 -> 1980 over 10m
route: fallback->us-east:h100
```

cameron: +1 to adding an alert on cross-pop fallback rate > 5% within 5m window. That seems predictive of p95 outage.

maya: will add to infra runbook. Action items: re-run with warm=1000, toggle routing policies (local-only, cost-priority), compare kernels (flash-attn-v2 vs fused-qk), capture KV miss rates. I'll upload CSVs and a small dashboard with p50/p95 heatmap per-pop.

frank: thanks — please tag infra and product when the dashboard lands. :eyes:

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: run/1912345678-rerun-warm1000 (ETA ~45m).

maya: will post results in this thread when complete.
